import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
globalThis.booted = spawnSync('sh', ['-c',
  `#!/bin/sh
systemctl is-system-running --quiet || exit 77
`]).status === 0;
test('acceptance: the engine restarts under the service manager', (t) => {
  if (!globalThis.booted) {
    t.skip('no init here');
    return;
  }
  assert.ok(true);
});
